title: DeepSTARR predicts enhancer activity and designs synthetic enhancers de novo
summary: A deep-learning model trained on Drosophila S2 STARR-seq data learned TF motifs and syntax rules, validated on >40,000 wild-type and mutant Drosophila and human enhancers, and designed synthetic enhancers with desired activity that were validated experimentally. Abstract-level review only.

evidence.tested: Rules and designs tested by reporter assays on >40,000 enhancers.
evidence.unknown: Fly cell-line context; generalization to other tissues not shown; full text not read.
evidence.ai_role: The CNN predicted activity from sequence, exposed motif syntax and guided enhancer design.
